info.title: ChatGPT web backend API (as observed)
info.description: Unofficial. OpenAI publishes no specification. Operations come from the call sites in the chatgpt.com page build; x-evidence says what else confirms each one (live request, archived bodies, this repository's code). Types are filled in only where confirmed; an empty schema means unknown. A query or body key is listed when a call site names it; x-query-dynamic and additionalProperties mark call sites that also pass keys the parser cannot read. Re-verify before relying on a field. Prose, rate limits and caveats: docs/chatgpt-backend-api.md.

get.summary: GET answers 405; the page calls this path with another method.

post.summary: Defaults, send block (blocked_features) and limits_progress. Response shape not recorded.

429.description: History-detail budget spent. Body {"detail":"Too many requests"}. Honour Retry-After; do not retry in a loop.

get.summary: Full conversation body. Under the history-detail budget.

patch.summary: Update a chat; {"is_archived": true} archives it.

get.summary: Whether a turn is generating. Cheap (21 bytes); not under the history-detail budget.
Sidebar list of chats (ids, titles, times).

post.summary: Chat metadata for up to 10 ids, no message bodies. Not under the history-detail budget.

429.description: History-detail budget spent. Body {"detail":"Too many requests"}. Honour Retry-After; do not retry in a loop.

get.summary: The page's own conversation load. Under the history-detail budget. Body shape not observed.
Projects (folders) for the sidebar. Answered 200 on 2026-11-22.
GET answers 404: no such route for GET.

bearer.description: accessToken from GET /api/auth/session (cookies only), sent from a page on the chatgpt.com origin with credentials included.

ConversationMeta.description: Chat metadata without message bodies (list item and batch item). Times are ISO-8601 strings.

status.description: COMPLETE when no turn runs (also for ids that do not exist); IS_STREAMING while a turn runs. IS_STREAMING was also seen on chats whose newest update was 28 h to 24 d old, so it does not prove a live turn. Other values are not observed.

content.description: Discriminated by content_type: code, thoughts, text, execution_output, multimodal_text, reasoning_recap, model_editable_context, user_editable_context, system_error, computer_output, tether_browsing_display, tether_quote.

Conversation.description: Full conversation body. Shape from archived bodies; times are epoch seconds here.
